project.name: orders-api
project.summary: Express 5 REST API in src/ (TypeScript) with Prisma (postgresql), Redis and BullMQ workers

full_suite.note: needs the test database and Redis running

data.check_command: pnpm exec prisma validate && pnpm exec prisma migrate status

house_rules: Routes are thin: validate with zod, call a service in src/services, return through the response helper.
Every Prisma write that spans more than one table runs in prisma.$transaction and uses tx inside it.
Errors are thrown as AppError subclasses and formatted only by the error middleware.
